# Docs should default to showing API for selected component, and not the hierarchy.

The docs for a given class shows the configs, methods, and event for the selected class, and for classes up the inheritance hierarchy. But users are most interested in the members introduced by the class. 

Every time I look up a class, one of the first things I do is de-select the ancestor classes. It would be a lot easier to start with the current class alone -- if needed, the user is still free to select classes up the hierarchy.

### Ticket Intake & Reality Classification (`ticket-intake`)

- **Prescription check (`§0`):** `Prescription checked: docs/app/view/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.mjs — owns the concern`. In `Docs.view.classdetails.HierarchyTreeList#createStoreItems` (`docs/app/view/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.mjs:79-91`), every item in the inheritance chain is pushed with `checked: true`. Changing `checked` to `key.neoClassName === className` checks only the selected class by default while leaving ancestors unchecked.
- **V-B-A Render-Sync Check:** Inspecting `Neo.tree.List#createItem` (`src/tree/List.mjs:230-282`), `HierarchyTreeList#onLeafItemClick` (`docs/app/view/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.mjs:100-112`), and `resources/scss/src/apps/docs/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.scss:1-15` shows that `.docs-classhierarchy-treelist .neo-list-item` renders a checked checkbox icon (`\f14a`) unless the `.unchecked` CSS class is present on the `<li>` node (`\f0c8`), and `TreeList#createItem` does not inspect `record.checked`. Therefore, `HierarchyTreeList` must also override `createItem(record)` to add `'unchecked'` to `itemVdom.cls` when `!record.checked` so initial VDOM rendering and subsequent `onLeafItemClick` toggles stay in sync with `record.checked`.
- **Core-Idiom Pre-Flight (`§1.9.6`):** Read and verified `src/core/Base.mjs`, `src/Neo.mjs`, `src/state/Provider.mjs`, `src/tree/List.mjs`, and `docs/app/view/classdetails/MembersList.mjs`.
- **Ticket age:** `createdAt: 2023-07-07T00:03:11Z`, `updatedAt: 2026-10-09T21:01:30Z` (reopened and validated by `@neo-opus-grace` in `IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABavGn8Q`).
- **Bot stale-band:** `pre-stale` (`stale: false`, `no auto close: false`).
- **Currency / successor-risk evidence:** Verified on live `dev` (`docs/app/view/classdetails/HierarchyTreeList.mjs:84`); no open or merged PR resolves `#4528`.
- **Verdict:** `valid-as-written` (Positive ROI).
